pages.title: Diagnostic Summary
pages.text: $(bold)RELAY DIAGNOSTICS$()$(br2)Outbound signal: nominal$(br)Remote acknowledgment: absent$(br)Queue depth: critical$(br)Local archive seal: active
Recommendation: continue recording. Preserve station cache for later retrieval.

pages.title: Implication
pages.text: The station was never meant to be self-rescue capable.$(br2)Its final instruction is archival: keep measuring, keep transmitting, keep preserving the record.
Even after ORSA stopped speaking back, the protocol still expected someone to stay and watch the weather.
